maddeler.e:
اغرنديت (form IIIq)
# اِغْرَنْدَيْتُ (iḡrandaytu) /iɣ.ran.daj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِغْرَنْدَى (iḡrandā)
# اِغْرَنْدَيْتَ (iḡrandayta) /iɣ.ran.daj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِغْرَنْدَى (iḡrandā)
# اِغْرَنْدَيْتِ (iḡrandayti) /iɣ.ran.daj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِغْرَنْدَى (iḡrandā)
# اُغْرُنْدِيتُ (uḡrundītu) /uɣ.run.diː.t
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
